run_worker_manager: run the WorkerManager class to manage thread and process-based runtimes for Launchpad programs
create_thread_worker: create a thread worker using WorkerManager.thread_worker to launch a function in a daemon thread
create_process_worker: create a process worker using WorkerManager.process_worker to spawn a subprocess command
wait_for_stop: wait for program termination using wait_for_stop or stop_event to block until the runtime stops
stop_and_wait_workers: stop and wait for all managed workers to terminate using WorkerManager.stop_and_wait or WorkerManager.wait
